allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Danila goes to his successful brother, Victor, in Petersburg to start a new life. Unknown to Danila, Victor is a contract killer, but is in hiding after asking for too much money to assassinate a Chechen mob boss. To avoid exposure, Victor convinces Danila to kill the boss instead.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Seeking a fresh start with his brother, Danila is pushed into the line of fire. Will he realize what Victor is hiding before the hit is carried out?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Arriving in Petersburg to build a fresh life with his successful brother, Danila discovers Victor is in hiding from mob fallout—and gets steered into executing a lethal contract hit in his place.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Grim, suspenseful Russian crime drama with heavy emotional weight, measured pacing, and steady engagement suited for solitary viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Aleksei Balabanov crafts a grounded, tense Russian crime drama where family loyalty turns hazardous, balancing grim street-level suspense with heavy emotional consequence.
